verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a merchant control to rate-limit, allowlist, or block specific AI agents or agent platforms from the catalog or checkout. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: Store Sync's promise that merchants control brand appearance and customer communications, PayPal-issued JWTs the merchant verifies on its cart endpoints, and configurable amount and time limits on single-use payment tokens. This is a fair axis for an agentic-commerce platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can rate-limit, allow, or deny specific agents and agent platforms accessing my catalog and checkout
